newsitem.title: SUDAN: Eritrean, Ethiopian rebels attack forces - reports.
newsitem.headline: Eritrean, Ethiopian rebels attack forces - reports.

text.p: Sudanese press reports on Saturday said that Eritrean and Ethiopian government forces suffered heavy losses in separate attacks by rebels in the two states.
The reports could not be independently confirmed.

The government-owned daily Al-Ingaz Al-Watani said the rebel Eritrean Liberation Front (ELF) killed 83 Eritrean forces last week in the north coast area of Ariri. Two tanks and military equipment were destroyed in the attack, it said.
Some government forces crossed into Sudanese territory to flee the battle, it added.
The paper quoted "a responsible source at the front as saying that ELF forces would escalate their attacks against the agent (Eritrean) regime until it falls."
Another paper, the privately-owned Akhbar Al-Youm said Ethiopian rebels waged "a fierce attack" on Ethiopian forces in the last few days.
"The (Ethiopian) government forces sustained huge losses in the attack during which an arms store ... was seized," the paper said.
The Khartoum government, under attack by its own rebels, has accused Eritrean and Ethiopian forces of direct involvement in the fight. Both countries deny the charge.
